items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: Well, yes, he traveled over the state of Texas.

ctx.x: So Lazy Daddy got over there?
Well, yes, he traveled over the state of Texas. Uh-huh. Troy didn't stay in Dallas, that was his home. He traveled over the state of Texas.
And Lazy Daddy, uh, would play there and, and you were there and they charged only a dollar ten.
